audit.whatIsWrong: The packet chart gives Camille six of seven stages against a 53.5% Garen win rate over 1987 games. The content and full charts do not: they read Garen / Garen / Skill / Skill / Camille / Camille / Camille, which is what the already-audited mirror (camille__garen) also settled on — Garen favoured at 1 and 2, skill phase at 3, Camille at 6. The difficulty framing is the part that is wrong: diff FAV at 8/10, 'Hard matchup', for a lane Garen wins.
audit.why: The mirror is authoritative on stage ownership and the two directions must not disagree, so the on-page chart stays. But an 8/10 hard rating on a 53.5% winning lane misprices it, and whys[1] and whys[2] argued for Camille on rows the chart gives to Garen and to Skill.
audit.corrected: Chart left as-is to stay mirror-consistent. whys[1] and whys[2] rewritten to argue for their own row. diff EVEN, diffRating 6.5/10, tone to the even colour.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appears anywhere on the level-6 spike, and report[5] tracks Hookshot at '11s' — that is its rank-5 value. Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12 and The Hextech Ultimatum is 140/115/90.
audit.why: Quoting the rank-5 number in lane makes the reader step up five seconds early. The 16s rank-1 Hookshot and the 140s rank-1 ultimate are the two numbers the whole lane is timed off.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] now carries Hookshot at 16s at rank 1 and spikes[1] The Hextech Ultimatum at 140s at rank 1; whys[4] repeats the 140s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interaction errors. (a) spikes[1] calls the ultimate 'Hextech Ultimatum' — the real name is The Hextech Ultimatum, and the packet flagged it. (b) Four fields say her W 'conquest heals' the damage off Judgment; Riot's text heals her only from enemies in the OUTER half of the cone. (c) Adaptive Defenses was never mentioned: it shields her against the damage type that just hit her, so an auto before the spin buys the shield out.
audit.why: The outer-half detail inverts the correct spacing — standing close to her removes her sustain entirely, while backing off gives it to her. And the shield is the reason a raw Q-into-E commit underperforms.
audit.corrected: The ultimate is now named in full and stated as an anchor with no immunity on the dash (matching the mirror's finding that the kit file's untargetable and channel flags on R are tooltip-parse misfires). Tactical Sweep's outer-half healing is stated with the spacing rule in spikes[0], mid and wants.you[2]. Adaptive Defenses and the bait-the-shield play added to early.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer is scraped source text: 'Garen Top Lane Matchup Database (1-70) 20' appears in tradeGood, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d and report[3].t, with a chart pasted into winCon, enemyWin and report[1].t. focus.text and dosFull[0].t read 'Camille Camille Hookshot wall jump and Q2 true damage'.
audit.why: These render to the reader as advice.
audit.corrected: Not repaired — outside the +/-10% band. Flagged for a structural pass.

edits.before: At 2 her Q true damage and E stun out-trade you.
edits.after: At 2 you still lead: Courage blunts her wall stun.

edits.before: Level 3 her hookshot engage and W heal control trades.
edits.after: At 3 it is even — she needs a wall, you need Courage.

edits.before: At 6 her Hextech Ultimatum locks you for the extended duel.
edits.after: At 6 The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you into a 1v1 — 140s.

edits.before: Camille takes over: her Q true-damage recast and E hookshot stun out-trade you, and her W conquest heals off the chunk your E does, so short trades go her way.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are even: Hookshot is 16s at rank 1 and needs a wall, and only Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her — stand inside the cone and she gets the damage without the sustain.

edits.before: Hextech Ultimatum locks you in a zone where she cannot be peeled off; combined with her Q resets she wins the extended duel even through your Perseverance.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum is 140s at rank 1 and anchors you into a 1v1 — the dash gives her no immunity, so hold Courage for the landing and answer with your own R.

edits.before: Level 1 is an even skill check — before she has Q and E online, your base damage trades roughly with hers, so use this window to farm and set the wave.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — Adaptive Defenses shields against the damage type that just hit her, so bait it with one auto before you spin, then farm and set the wave.

edits.before: From level 2 Camille controls the lane: her Q true-damage recasts and E hookshot stun out-trade you, her W conquest heals the damage off your Judgment, and she picks the engage. Do not trade unless her E is down.
edits.after: From level 2 Camille contests the lane: her Q recasts do true damage and Hookshot stuns off a wall, but only Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her. Stand inside the cone, and do not trade unless her E is down.

edits.before: Buy Bramble/Grievous to cut her W conquest healing
edits.after: Buy Bramble to cut Tactical Sweep's outer-half heal

edits.before: Ult you into the zone with your R and flash down
edits.after: Anchor you with R once your Courage is spent

notes: Stage ownership was left exactly as the mirror (audits/top/camille__garen.json) settled it — Garen at 1 and 2, skill phase at 3, Camille at 6 — so the two directions agree. The packet levelChart for this matchup (Camille 6 of 7) disagrees with both pages and with the 53.5% win rate; it is the stale artefact and should be regenerated from the full layer. Per the mirror's finding, the untargetable and channel flags on Camille's R in the kit file are tooltip-parse misfires: Riot's description is a dash plus an anchoring zone, no immunity frame, and I wrote from the description. Full layer still contains scraped PDF text and needs regeneration.
